NEW DELHI: India's star wicketkeeper batter Rishabh Pant created history on Tuesday during the first Test against Sri Lanka in Galle. The India wicketkeeper-batter became the first Indian cricketer to hit 100 sixes in Test cricket.Pant reached the milestone with a big six off Lahiru Kumara. The shot also brought up his 20th Test fifty.Pant became only the fourth batter in Test history to hit 100 sixes. Ben Stokes leads the list with 138 sixes, followed by Brendon McCullum with 107. Pant is now third with 100 sixes, while former Australia wicketkeeper Adam Gilchrist also has 100.Pant reached the landmark in his aggressive style against Kumara. The Sri Lankan pacer bowled a delivery on a length and angled it into the left-hander. Pant got inside the line and pulled it over long leg.Nuwantha tried to catch the ball but could only watch it sail over the boundary.The six also brought up Pant's fifty, his 20th in Test cricket.With the shot, Pant became the first Indian and only the fourth batter overall to reach 100 sixes in Test cricket.

Article Title: ‘Increase drug testing from 10% to 25% for pilots:’ FIA to DGCA chief Vir Vikram Yadav
Article Text:
FIP has identified certain medicines that may impact flight safety by causing drowsiness or sedation; impairing judgement or reaction time; reducing alertness and resulting in a positive or non-negative drug test.

NEW DELHI: As the Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) reviews the dope test requirement for flight crew members, the Federation of Indian Pilots (FIP) has asked the regulator to amend the current requirement for an operator to subject at least 10 per cent of pilots to this test annually to at least 25 per cent. FIP president Captain CS Randhawa has said in a mail to DGCA chief Vir Vikram Yadav that all stakeholders must establish a pilot “psychoactive-substance and medication awareness programme” to make sure every pilot understands “certain prescription medicines, over-the-counter (OTC) medicines, herbal preparations, supplements and other commonly available products may contain substances that can affect alertness, performance or produce a finding in a drug or alcohol test.”FIP has identified certain medicines that may impact flight safety by causing drowsiness or sedation; impairing judgement or reaction time; reducing alertness and resulting in a positive or non-negative drug test. “Particular attention should be given to: cough and cold preparations, as some preparations may contain alcohol, sedating antihistamines or other active ingredients that may affect fitness for duty.Antihistamines and anti-allergy medicines (that may)may cause significant sedation and impaired alertness; sleep and anxiety medicines; strong pain-relieving medicines; prescription psychiatric or neurological medicines; herbal and traditional medicines and supplements and performance products and alcohol-containing medicines and preparations.” It has recommended a “check before you take” principle for pilots and that they should not start taking a new medicine without checking it for these things.“A minimum percentage established several years ago should not remain static when the aviation environment, fleet size, pilot population and operational intensity have changed substantially. For pilots entrusted with the lives of passengers and crew, random psychoactive substance testing must be sufficiently frequent, genuinely random and unpredictable to provide meaningful deterrence and continuous safety assurance.The objective should not merely be to achieve an annual numerical target, but to establish a testing regime in which the possibility of selection remains credible throughout the year,” FIP president Captain C S Randhawa wrote to the DGCA chief Vir Vikram Yadav.Since the result of a urine test takes a long time and the percentage of tests have sought to be increased, the pilots’ body has asked DGCA to consider “validated oral-fluid testing as a complementary methodology, alongside the established urine-testing system.”
Article Summary: The federation of indian pilots (fip) has asked the regulator to amend the current requirement for an operator to subject at least 10 per cent of pilots to this test annually. Fip president captain cs randhawa has said in a mail to dgca chief vir vikram yadav that all stakeholders must establish a pilot “psychoactive-substance and medication awareness programme”

Article Title: "I think he just encouraged me. He’s so great”: How Chiefs star Patrick Mahomes’ relentless rehab approach inspired an NFL veteran through his own ACL recovery
Article Text:

How Patrick Mahomes’ aggressive rehab approach pushed Zach Ertz through his ACL recovery

Why Zach Ertz’s recovery also gave Patrick Mahomes a competitive push

When Patrick Mahomes suffered a serious knee injury, he suddenly faced one of the toughest stretches of his NFL career. But the Kansas City Chiefs quarterback was not alone. Zach Ertz was going through a similar ACL recovery, and Mahomes’ approach became a source of motivation for the veteran tight end.Their recovery turned into a quiet competition. They exchanged messages, shared progress and pushed each other through difficult days. For Ertz, Mahomes’ aggressive approach stood out and gave him another reason to keep attacking his own comeback.Patrick Mahomes tore his ACL and LCL in his left knee during the Chiefs’ Week 15 loss to the Los Angeles Chargers. The injury came only one week after Zach Ertz suffered a torn ACL against the Minnesota Vikings.The similar injuries created an unusual connection between the two NFL veterans. Both faced lengthy rehabilitation after undergoing the same repair surgery. They knew the road back would test them physically, but the mental side could prove just as difficult.Mahomes reached out to Ertz during that period, and the two began sharing updates about their rehabilitation. They could talk about the parts of recovery that teammates and friends might not fully understand.That included the frustration of doing the same exercises repeatedly without seeing obvious changes.For Ertz, Mahomes’ approach stood out. The Chiefs quarterback did not seem interested in taking the easy route. Instead, he attacked each stage of his rehabilitation with the same competitive edge that has defined his career.“I think he just encouraged me how aggressive he was. It’s not surprising why he’s so great. He attacks everything,” Ertz told The Athletic while discussing their shared recovery journey.That comment explains why Mahomes became more than just a fellow injured player for Ertz. His work ethic gave the veteran tight end something to follow during the toughest parts of his own recovery.Ertz also opened up about the mental challenge. Physical rehabilitation can become frustrating when the effort does not immediately produce visible results.“It’s tough not seeing those immediate results,” Ertz said to The Athletic. “And I think that is probably the toughest part, mentally just grinding through those difficult days where it’s not getting tangibly better objectively.”Having Mahomes on a similar recovery path helped Ertz deal with that uncertainty. They could compare their progress, encourage each other and keep their competitive edge alive even while they remained away from the field.The support worked both ways. Mahomes also found value in having someone who understood the daily grind of rehabilitation.“You feel like sometimes you’re lonely, because you’re doing stuff by yourself and you’re just competing against yourself,” Mahomes said while discussing the recovery. “So it gave me someone else I can compete with to push my competitive drive.”That connection gave both players something extra during rehab. Instead of facing every difficult session alone, they had another player who understood the pain, frustration and uncertainty.For Ertz, Mahomes’ approach showed what it meant to attack recovery instead of simply waiting for it to end. For the Chiefs quarterback, Ertz provided a teammate-like presence during a difficult stretch.Their shared experience turned a painful setback into a source of motivation. Mahomes kept pushing forward, and Ertz found another reason to do the same. What began as two NFL stars dealing with serious injuries became a partnership that helped both players chase their return to football.
Article Summary: Patrick mahomes tore his acl and lcl in his left knee during the chiefs’ week 15 loss to the los angeles chargers. The injury came only one week after zach ertz suffered a torn acl against the minnesota vikings. Mahomes reached out to ertz during that period and the two began sharing updates about their rehabilitation.

Article Title: ‘Ball was on the ground’: Ex-cricketer baffled as Dhruv Jurel catch sparks controversy
Article Text:
India's Dhruv Jurel attempts a catch (PTI Photo)

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

India moved within touching distance of victory in the Galle Test on Tuesday, making repeated breakthroughs in Sri Lanka's batting order to leave themselves needing six more wickets on the final day to take a 1-0 lead in the two-match series.But the fourth day's play was overshadowed by a contentious third-umpire decision involving wicketkeeper Dhruv Jurel, whose catch to dismiss Sri Lanka opener Lahiru Udara triggered debate among fans and commentators.The incident took place on the fourth ball of the 22nd over, with Manav Suthar bowling. Jurel completed the catch, but Udara immediately appeared unsure whether the ball had been taken cleanly. The matter was referred to third umpire Raveendra Wimalasiri, with replays showing the ball going into Jurel's hands but leaving some doubt over whether his fingers were underneath it.Jurel had held the ball with his right hand and, as his momentum carried him forward, there appeared to be a possibility that the ball had made contact with the ground. Wimalasiri, however, was satisfied with the available evidence and ruled Udara out.Udara was visibly unhappy with the decision and appeared reluctant to leave the field. The Sri Lankan opener had made 16 off 58 balls before being forced to walk back to the pavilion.Former Sri Lanka batter Russel Arnold , who was part of the commentary team, was also not convinced that the catch was clean. He felt the ball had touched the ground and believed Udara should have remained at the crease.“It's been pushed along the ground for a bit. The ball was pushed along the ground. You can see, it was pushed along. When you look at that slow-motion replay, it seems that the fingers were pushed back and the front of the ball was touching the ground,” Arnold said on air.“For me, the ball is on the ground there. The fingers are behind the ball,” he added.India had set Sri Lanka a target of 372 after being dismissed for 193 in their second innings. Rishabh Pant top-scored with 66 and also became the first Asian batter to cross 100 sixes in Test cricket.Sri Lanka struggled during their chase as India picked up four wickets before stumps. Suthar claimed two, while Mohammed Siraj and Prasidh Krishna took one each.The hosts finished the fourth day on 84/4 and still require 288 runs to pull off a remarkable victory. With rain forecast for the final day, India will have to negotiate the weather as they look to complete a 1-0 series lead in Galle.
Article Summary: Wicketkeeper dhruv jurel's catch to dismiss sri lanka opener lahiru udara triggered debate among fans and commentators. The incident took place on the fourth ball of the 22nd over, with manav suthar bowling. Udara appeared unsure whether the ball had been taken cleanly. The matter was referred to third umpire raveendra wimalasiri.

Anze Kopitar and his family are getting used to life in Slovenia after more than 20 years in Southern California. The former Kings captain had long hinted a return to his homeland would be part of his post-career plans, meaning the move was a considered step rather than a spur-of-the-moment decision. It is, nonetheless, a major life change for Kopitar, who spent his entire NHL career in Los Angeles and became one of the more iconic figures in franchise history.The deal comes right after Kopitar’s final NHL season in 2026-27. The Slovenian center’s career was capped with 1,521 regular-season games and 1,316 points, establishing him as one of the most productive and respected players in Kings’ history. His consistency, leadership and two-way excellence helped define an era of success for the franchise.Anze Kopitar’s family is dealing with shipping and customs delays as their belongings are shipped from California to Slovenia.Moving abroad is often a complicated process, and this one has added a new level of inconvenience to a return home that has been long in the planning. Household goods shipped across continents are usually subject to detailed customs checks and documentation and clearance processes that can hold up the release.So families can be left without necessities for a time while they wait for shipments to come in.After retiring, Anze Kopitar returned home to Slovenia primarily to spend more time with his family and to reconnect with his roots, but the move is not just a reflection of family factors; it also reflects Kopitar’s deep personal ties to Slovenia. He and his wife are both Slovenian, and the majority of their extended family still resides there. Going home allows them to reconnect with family more closely and to more fully integrate their children into their cultural heritage.Anze Kopitar played the final game of his 20-year NHL career with the Los Angeles Kings, finishing as one of the franchise’s most decorated players.He retired after playing 1,521 regular-season games and scoring 452 goals and adding 864 assists for a total of 1,316 points, according to NHL records and a Reuters report. He also won two Stanley Cup championships, in 2012 and 2014, which remain defining moments in modern Kings history.Kopitar’s impact in L.A. is more than the numbers. He was team captain for many years and commanded great respect for his leadership, professionalism and consistency on and off the ice. To honour his accomplishments, the Kings announced they will retire his No. 11 jersey and unveil a statue of him outside Crypto.com Arena on Feb.24, 2027, before a game against the Montreal Canadiens.Ultimately, Kopitar’s move is the closing of a defining North American chapter and the start of a quieter life back home in Slovenia. The transition has been complicated by logistical challenges such as customs delays, but it is a move that has been long planned to go home to family, heritage and life after professional hockey.

The transition has been complicated by logistical challenges such as customs delays, but it is a move that has been long planned.

Pep Guardiola and Cristina Serra ended their marriage after more than 30 years together. They even decided to use the same lawyer, in an unusual arrangement designed to avoid a difficult legal battle. So she says normally to me, don’t wear this or wear that, so I follow her.”The pair later built a long-term relationship and married in 2014. She moved back to Barcelona to run her family business while Guardiola continued his football career in England.Pep Guardiola and Cristina Serra waited many years before getting married. The couple tied the knot in 2014. They held a private ceremony in Catalonia, Spain. Their relationship had already lasted for many years by that point.Guardiola’s football career had also developed significantly. Article Title: Throwback: When Khabib Nurmagomedov put his UFC lightweight title on Islam Makhachev’s table with 3 powerful words: “future UFC champ”

Islam Makhachev is now a UFC champion across two weight divisions. He has also broken the promotion’s record for consecutive wins. But years before Makhachev reached the top, Khabib Nurmagomedov appeared to know exactly where his teammate was heading. A viral throwback moment from 2019 has brought that prediction back into focus.During UFC 242 fight week in Abu Dhabi, Nurmagomedov walked up behind Makhachev during a media interaction. He placed his UFC lightweight championship belt on the table in front of him. Nurmagomedov then delivered a simple message that would later look remarkably accurate:Future UFC champ”.The memorable moment happened in September 2019, during one of the biggest weeks in Khabib Nurmagomedov’s career. The undefeated Dagestani champion was preparing to defend his lightweight title against Dustin Poirier at UFC 242.Makhachev was also competing on the same card. He faced Davi Ramos and won the fight by unanimous decision.At the time, Makhachev was still viewed as a rising contender. He had not yet become the dominant champion that fans know today.That made Nurmagomedov’s gesture even more interesting.While Makhachev was speaking to reporters, Khabib Nurmagomedov approached him from behind.He placed his championship belt on the table and called his close friend and training partner the “Future UFC champ.”Makhachev appeared visibly humbled by the moment. He smiled and thanked Khabib.The prediction was not simply a random compliment.Nurmagomedov and Makhachev had grown up around the same fighting system created by their late coach, Abdulmanap Nurmagomedov. They trained together for years and became close friends.Nurmagomedov eventually became one of the greatest fighters in UFC history. He retired undefeated with a 29-0 professional record.Makhachev then followed a similar path.He won the vacant UFC lightweight championship at UFC 280 in 2022. He submitted Charles Oliveira to claim the title and later defended it four times.The throwback clip now carries even more weight because Makhachev has gone beyond the prediction.He eventually moved to welterweight and captured a second UFC championship by defeating Jack Della Maddalena. He then defended the welterweight title against Ian Machado Garry at UFC 330.That victory also pushed Makhachev’s UFC winning streak to 17 fights. He moved past Anderson Silva’s previous record of 16 consecutive UFC victories.Khabib celebrated the achievement on social media. In the post caption he wrote, “There is a word : Achievement. In sport it has a great significance, Islam and the word Achievement are synonyms)))) he achieved great heights in this sport, broke the record of series wins in UFC history, and is rightfully one of the best athletes to ever enter the octagon. May the Almighty keep you well, brother.”The 2019 moment therefore looks almost prophetic today. What began as a simple gesture from one friend to another became a remarkable prediction of what was to come.
Article Summary: Islam makhachev is now a ufc champion across two weight divisions. He has also broken the promotion’s record for consecutive wins. Khabib nurmagomedov appeared to know exactly where his teammate was heading. A viral throwback moment from 2019 has brought that prediction back into focus.

Article Title: Super Bowl LXI lands on Valentine’s Day for the first time in history creating an unusual football-versus-romance showdown

Super Bowl 2027 brings another major change for NFL fans

Super Bowl LXI is about to create a very unusual sporting dilemma. The NFL ’s championship game is scheduled for February 14, 2027, putting it on Valentine’s Day for the first time in Super Bowl history. With romance and football competing for the same Sunday, fans have already begun joking about dinner reservations, watch parties and the ultimate relationship compromise.The date alone is enough to make the 2027 Super Bowl stand out. The game will take place at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, California, on February 14, meaning couples will have to decide how they want to spend one of the biggest nights on the American sporting calendar.For football fans, the answer may seem obvious. For couples with different priorities, however, the evening could require some negotiation.Social media has already embraced the idea. One Reddit commenter joked about the pressure on restaurants, writing:"The Valentine's Day brunch reservations are going to be harder to get than a Super Bowl ticket."Another post took the joke even further, imagining the holiday as a test of romantic loyalty:"Super Bowl on Valentine's? Peak relationship apocalypse incoming—guys choosing touchdowns over touchy-feely dates. Ladies, demand a halftime proposal or it's single season next year."The humor works because the conflict is so easy to imagine. A romantic dinner could overlap with pregame coverage. A reservation might clash with kickoff.And anyone hosting a Super Bowl party could suddenly find themselves planning around Valentine's Day expectations.There is also a convenient escape route. The game falls on Presidents' Day weekend, giving many people the chance to turn the occasion into a longer celebration. Couples could celebrate Valentine's Day on Saturday, watch the Super Bowl on Sunday and use Monday to recover from the late night.The unusual date is not the only reason Super Bowl LXI will be significant. ESPN will broadcast the championship game for the first time in network history, with ABC also carrying the event. ESPN has already outlined extensive programming and storytelling designed to build anticipation well before the game itself.The timing also feeds into a broader conversation about the Super Bowl calendar. The NFL has long faced calls to make the Monday after the championship game a national holiday, particularly because fans already tend to treat Presidents' Day weekend as a natural extension of Super Bowl celebrations.Commissioner Roger Goodell has previously discussed how changes to the NFL schedule could eventually push the Super Bowl toward Presidents' Day weekend. In comments cited in the original report, he said:"I think if you went to 18 weeks regular season that would probably occur," Goodell said at the time. "It is possible somewhere in the calendar. Could happen before that just because of the calendar, the way it lays out.But I think 18 weeks would get you to that point, and I think it would be a really great move."For now, February 14, 2027 remains a one-of-a-kind collision between football and romance. The NFL has confirmed the date, and fans have plenty of time to decide whether Super Bowl Sunday will be a date-night disaster, a couples' tradition or simply the perfect excuse to order wings and watch football together.

Brock Lesnar and Ric Flair are two of the biggest names in professional wrestling. But they have had very different experiences in terms of money. Lesnar was a crossover combat-sports star after excelling in amateur wrestling, WWE and the UFC, while Flair made his name over more than four decades in WCW and WWE.But there is a big gap, and public net-worth numbers are best seen as estimates, not audited financial statements. Lesnar’s contracts in the modern era, UFC purses and limited-appearance model allowed him to make individual paydays that were much larger than what was generally available to wrestlers during Flair’s peak years. Meanwhile, Flair continues to earn from his name, appearances, licensing and wrestling-related projects, despite the financial difficulties that have beset his wealth over the years.Brock Lesnar seems to be in a better financial state at the moment. Celebrity Net Worth estimates his net worth at $10 million, whereas NDTV reported an estimate of $17 million in June 2026. Other outlets have published higher numbers, a testament to the uncertainties that come with calculating celebrity net worth.Ric Flair is worth much less. His net worth has been estimated to be $500,000 by Celebrity Net Worth, but other estimates online have put the figure at a much higher number.The variation reflects the absence of publicly verified personal financial records, and the challenge of calculating assets, liabilities, royalties and ongoing income for a longtime entertainer.Lesnar’s wealth is intrinsically tied to his ability to command top dollar. He was an instant star in WWE after debuting in 2002, but he later moved away from the wrestling world to try his hand at the NFL and mixed martial arts before returning to WWE as an established crossover star.Lesnar’s career in WWE has been as much about scarcity as it has been about star power. He was often employed on a limited schedule around major storylines and premium live events for most of his later career instead of working weekly.Lesnar’s UFC career distinguished his money story from most WWE stars. After leaving professional wrestling, he came into MMA and immediately became a big draw. Beating Randy Couture for the heavyweight championship at UFC 91 made him a legit heavyweight champion and gave him a serious bump in commercial appeal.Lesnar has also earned money from endorsements and appearances. Jimmy John’s and other commercial deals are among his previous endorsement deals, and his celebrity status has helped his value outside the ring.He has also kept his lifestyle very private. Recent reports have pointed out that he prefers a rural lifestyle and owning vast amounts of land, rather than the high-profile celebrity lifestyle that many sports stars enjoy.Ric Flair’s financial story started in an era when the economics of professional wrestling were very different. The Nature Boy became one of the defining stars of the National Wrestling Alliance, World Championship Wrestling and WWE, headlining big events and winning championships through a career that spanned several decades.Flair made a ton of money in his time with WCW. One published estimate puts his WCW earnings from 1996-2000 at about $1.95 million. But the size of his earnings did not translate directly into lasting wealth because of taxes, legal obligations, medical expenses and other financial pressures.He also made a lot of money from his WWE career. Flair was a wrestler, manager and personality and stayed a close associate of the company for years. In 2005, during a divorce hearing, it was revealed that his annual WWE salary was reportedly around $500,000, showing how much he could make from wrestling even later in his career.Of the two stars, Flair's financial history is the starkest contrast. Celebrity Net Worth states that in 2000, the IRS filed a lien of more than $870,000 against him, and his further tax problems damaged his finances. The same source reports that in 2019 there was a major medical emergency that resulted in a medical bill of approximately $1.8 million.These pressures help explain why lifetime earnings and current net worth can look so dramatically different. Making millions in a career doesn’t always translate to keeping millions after taxes, debts, medical expenses and other costs.Lesnar’s future financial prospects will probably continue to be linked to his standing as a top-tier combat sports attraction. As his active wrestling career is changing, his name still has value for special appearances, merchandise, licensing and media projects.Flair’s earning model is a unique one. At 77, his money-making opportunities are increasingly linked to his legacy rather than regular ring competition. He still turns up at wrestling events, signs autographs and does other promotional stuff.Lesnar has a path to victory in the modern economics of sports and one of the rare WWE-to-UFC crossover careers. Flair’s financial legacy isn’t so much the wealth he has today, but the incredible value he brought to pro wrestling in terms of sales. Their careers demonstrate two different paths a wrestling superstar can take to earn money: Lesnar with premium modern contracts and crossover sports earnings, and Flair with longevity, character, championships and lasting brand recognition.

Lesnar was a crossover combat-sports star after excelling in amateur wrestling, wwe and the ufc. Flair made his name over more than four decades in wcw and wwe.

The New Jersey Devils will enter the 2026-27 season without a clear No. 1 goaltender, but Hall-of-Fame goalie Martin Brodeur believes Nico Daws deserves a real chance to take the job. After moving Jacob Markstrom to the Florida Panthers, New Jersey has left the door open for a new starter to emerge.Jake Allen and David Rittich are also in the mix, but Daws could have the biggest opportunity of his young NHL career. Brodeur, who serves as the Devils’ executive vice president of hockey operations, believes the 25-year-old deserves an opportunity to show what he can do in the NHL.According to Brodeur, the Devils are comfortable letting their goaltenders compete for the starting job rather than naming a clear No. 1 before the season begins. “The best starter is going to get the net,” Brodeur told The Hockey News. “I don't think there's a clear-cut No. 1 goalie in net.”That gives Daws a real opening. The 2020 third-round pick has spent much of his career moving between the NHL and AHL, and Brodeur believes the Devils have not given him enough chances to show what he can do.“Nico Daws is a kid who needs a chance,” Brodeur said. “We've been developing him for four years.We didn't put great teams in front of him in Utica and obviously his development slowed down because of that. But we need to give him a chance to see what we have.”While Daws has limited NHL experience, he has already delivered one performance that stands out. In the Stadium Series game against the Philadelphia Flyers at MetLife Stadium, he stopped 51 shots. Brodeur still remembers that performance when discussing Daws’ potential.“We put him into the Stadium Series game at MetLife Stadium in front of 70,000 people and he had 51 saves against the Flyers. He's got it, I really believe in him, we just never gave him a chance,” Brodeur said.That belief could be important for Daws as he competes with Allen and Rittich. Allen brings much more NHL experience, while Rittich has also spent years in the league. But neither has been locked into a heavy workload in recent seasons.Brodeur acknowledged that Markstrom will be missed but believes the current group can give New Jersey what it needs.“Jake showed us a lot last year when he had to play. Article Title: Inspiring story on motherhood by Naomi Osaka: “Taking care of myself is part of taking care of my daughter”- Tennis star reveals how self-care changed her approach to parenting
Article Text:
Inspiring story on motherhood by Naomi Osaka: “Taking care of myself is part of taking care of my daughter”- Tennis star reveals how self-care changed her approach to parenting

What did Naomi Osaka mean when she said self-care is part of motherhood ?

How did becoming a mother change Naomi Osaka’s view of tennis?

Why are boundaries so important to Osaka as a mother?

What can mothers learn from Naomi Osaka’s mental-health journey?

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

For Naomi Osaka, becoming a mother did not mean putting her own needs aside. Instead, it changed the way she thinks about self-care, mental health and life. The four-time Grand Slam champion, who has been open about her struggles with anxiety and pressure, has shared a simple but powerful message: “Taking care of myself is part of taking care of my daughter. ” Her words show why looking after yourself can also be an important part of being a good mother.Osaka became a mother in July 2023 when she welcomed her daughter, Shai, with rapper Cordae. Her journey into motherhood came during a major change in her life. She had stepped away from tennis for more than a year and was also trying to understand what she wanted from her career and her life.For Osaka, self-care is not about putting herself before her daughter. It is about making sure she is in a good place so she can also be there for her child.In her conversations about motherhood and mental health, Osaka has spoken about setting boundaries, taking time for herself and paying attention to what she needs. That can mean taking a quiet moment, meditating, getting enough rest when possible or simply saying no when something feels like too much.Her message also pushes back against the idea that mothers must always put themselves last.Being a mother does not mean a woman has to ignore her own feelings, needs or identity.Osaka’s approach is simple. A mother can love her child deeply and still need time for herself. In fact, taking care of her own mental and emotional health can help her be more present for her child.Tennis had been a huge part of Osaka’s life for years. She became world No. 1 and won four Grand Slam singles titles, including the US Open in 2018 and the Australian Open in 2019, 2021 and 2022.But success also came with pressure. Osaka made headlines in 2021 when she withdrew from the French Open after explaining that media duties were affecting her mental health. She later stepped away from tennis for an extended period.Becoming a mother gave her another chance to look at her life from a different point of view.Osaka returned to professional tennis in January 2024 after giving birth. The comeback was not easy. She had to rebuild her body, return to the demands of professional sport and deal with the normal ups and downs of competition.But motherhood also helped her understand that tennis was only one part of who she was.Winning was still important to her, but it was no longer the only thing that defined her. She could be a tennis player, a mother and her own person at the same time.That change in thinking also helped Osaka become more open about her emotions. Instead of feeling that she always had to appear strong, she became more comfortable talking about difficult moments and asking for support.Osaka has spent much of her career in the public eye. Her matches, interviews and personal life have all received huge attention. That level of attention can be difficult for anyone, and motherhood has given her even more reason to protect her private life and mental space.She has spoken about how hard it once was for her to say no because she worried about disappointing people. Over time, she learned that she could not make everyone happy and did not have to accept every demand placed on her.That lesson became an important part of how she approaches motherhood.For Osaka, boundaries can mean choosing when to work, taking time away from social media, protecting family time or simply refusing to take on something that could leave her overwhelmed.These choices are not about shutting people out. They are about knowing when she needs to step back.Her experience also sends an important message to other mothers. Saying no does not mean you care less. Taking a break does not mean you are lazy. Asking someone for help does not mean you have failed.Sometimes, protecting your own peace is what allows you to give more of yourself to the people you love.Perhaps the biggest lesson from Osaka’s story is that mental health should not be treated as something people have to hide.She has spoken openly about anxiety, pressure and the challenges that came with being a top athlete. She has also talked about wanting her daughter to grow up in an environment where talking about feelings is normal.Osaka has encouraged the idea that children should be able to express themselves, ask for help and understand their emotions. She has also talked about simple habits such as meditation, quiet time and spending meaningful time with family.For her, these lessons are not only things she can tell her daughter. They are things she can show her through her own actions.When a mother rests when she needs to, she shows her child that rest is important. When she talks about her feelings, she shows that emotions are normal. When she asks for help, she teaches her child that nobody has to deal with everything alone.That may be one of the most important parts of Osaka’s message.Motherhood does not have to mean losing yourself. A woman can still have dreams, a career, friendships, personal goals and time for herself while being a loving and devoted mother.Osaka’s journey shows that self-care is not about choosing yourself instead of your child. It is about making sure you are also cared for.For the tennis star, that balance has become part of the mother she wants to be. Her words, “Taking care of myself is part of taking care of my daughter,” capture that idea in the simplest way. Taking care of yourself is not taking love away from your child. Sometimes, it is what helps you give that love with more patience, energy and presence.
Article Summary: Naomi osaka became a mother in july 2023 when she welcomed her daughter, shai, with rapper cordae. The four-time grand slam champion has shared a simple but powerful message: “taking care of myself is part of taking care of my daughter. ” osaka has spoken openly about anxiety, pressure and the challenges that came with being a top athlete.

David Beckham reflects on parenthood amid drama with Brooklyn Beckham

David Beckham, the football legend, and his wife, Victoria Beckham, have been in the public eye for close to three decades due to their successful careers. While the two have always been united when it came to challenges in their lives, David Beckham and Victoria Beckham are still dealing with a public feud concerning their oldest son, Brooklyn Beckam, and their daughter in law, Nicola Peltz.In a recent interview with the Wall Street Journal, fashion icon and former pop star Victoria Beckham opened up about parenthood as she said, "I think that we've always - we love our children so much.Victoria Beckham added, "We've always tried to be the best parents that we can be. And you know, we've been in the public eye for more than 30 years right now, and all we've ever tried to do is protect our children and love our children."Contrary to Victoria Beckham’s comments about parenthood, Brooklyn Beckham has not backed down from the controversial accusations he made against them.For the unversed, a few months ago, in January 2026 Brooklyn Beckham took to his social media to make a post that read as, "My parents have been trying endlessly to ruin my relationship since before my wedding, and it hasn't stopped.”The post added, “My mum cancelled making Nicola's dress in the eleventh hour despite how excited she was to wear her design, forcing her to urgently find a new dress.Weeks before our big day, my parents repeatedly pressured and attempted to bribe me into signing away the rights to my name, which would have affected me, my wife, and our future children.”Both David Beckham and his wife, Victoria Beckham, have refused to comment on Brooklyn Beckham’s accusations.While David Beckham has remained distant from Brooklyn Beckham in public, he has spoken about parenthood.The Manchester United legend said, “I would like to say that I brought my children up with the same values as what my Dad and Mum taught me and my sisters. “My kids are very polite. My kids are very well-mannered.”The 50 year old football icon added, “My kids are humble, and they all have the same values as what I have and my wife has. That’s the proudest thing that we have as parents, in all honesty.”He continued, “Family has always been important, and the greatest thing [Victoria Beckham] has ever given me is my four children.”Over the last few months, David Beckham and Victoria Beckham have remained united and have tried to focus on their respective careers and life.
